name: Slime Ducts (Tomb Jelly)
text:
Nearly invisible ducts in your skin secrete a layer of slime that coats your flesh.

Activate—Secrete Slime 1 (concentrate)

Requirements You activate the ducts, covering yourself with a thin layer of slime

---
Effect The slime covering you is corrosive to organic material, eating away any other flesh that comes in contact with you. A creature that touches you takes 1d6 acid damage. The slime lasts for 10 minutes or until you Dismiss the effect.
